svg.title: Five production failure modes
svg.desc: Five failure modes that recur in production agent incidents. Context exhaustion: tool results pile up until the context window is full and the next call is rejected. Schema drift: the model calls a tool with parameters from an older schema version. Partial failure: some parallel tool calls succeed and some fail. Ambiguous timeout: a request times out after the server may already have processed it, so a retry can execute it twice. Observability gaps: without structured logs of tool calls there is no record of what the agent tried.
